notes: §1985:IX.3.2.4 GR4: "The LABEL RECORDS clause for the Indexed I-O module is the same as the LABEL RECORDS clause for the Sequential I-O module": the format LABEL {RECORD IS | RECORDS ARE} {STANDARD | OMITTED} (§1985:VII.3.6.2), STANDARD meaning "the labels conform to the implementor's label specifications" (§1985:VII.3.6.3 GR2; no label is read or written, docs/conformance/3.7), and for an external connector "all LABEL RECORDS clauses in the run unit which are associated with this file connector must have the same specification" (§1985:VII.3.6.3 GR4). labelRecordsClause is that format since kb/Work PB5070, admitted in the indexed format by Rows; CaptureLabelRecords records the option and ExternalFileConnectorRules.Check runs CheckFileDescriptions below 2002 over FileDescriptionIdentity.Rules (kb/Work PB5300, landed), COBOL6847 at the clause; VisitLabelRecordsClause refuses the clause from 2002. Probed at --std 85, 2026-11-14 tree dc1f2dcce8: (b) STANDARD, OMITTED, every optional word dropped run; refused: no option, STANDARD OMITTED, IGNORED, a user word STANDARD-X (COBOL5506), LABEL ARE, RECORDS IS, RECORD ARE (COBOL5506), the clause twice (COBOL2423); external connector across two programs of one source: indexed STANDARD vs OMITTED refused (COBOL6847), and the relative and sequential twins too; STANDARD vs STANDARD in the other spelling, OMITTED vs OMITTED, and a clause in one entry only, compile and run (SUB WROTE / MAIN OK); (c) refused at 2002, 2014, 2023; (e) OPEN INPUT of a missing indexed file under each clause gives status 35 and the READ after it 47. The prior PARTIAL (format operands and GR4 agreement unchecked) is fixed. The witness is an indexed FD with LABEL RECORDS ARE STANDARD that runs and displays LABEL RECORDS OK. History: until the 1985 re-read 5 (2026-11-14) this row read PARTIAL, naming kb/Work PB5069 (landed), kb/Work PB5070 (landed); the re-read of main dc1f2dcce8 found that defect fixed by the landing of kb/Work PB5070 and kb/Work PB5300 and records CONFORMS, upheld by an independent refuter (code read: op-20261114/out-reread5/rs-03.json, refuter op-20261114/out-reread5/rs-03-refute.json).
